vendor_profile_not_blank_check.name: vendor_profile_not_blank_check
vendor_profile_not_blank_check.value: btrim("legal_name") <> '' and btrim("nib") <> '' and btrim("pse_number") <> '' and btrim("npwp") <> '' and btrim("meta_business_id") <> '' and btrim("website") <> '' and btrim("privacy_url") <> '' and btrim("support_email") <> '' and btrim("support_phone") <> ''

vendor_profile_pkp_check.name: vendor_profile_pkp_check
vendor_profile_pkp_check.value: not "vendor_profile"."is_pkp" or ("vendor_profile"."pkp_effective_from" is not null and "vendor_profile"."tax_evidence_ref" is not null)

vendor_profile_residency_check.name: vendor_profile_residency_check
vendor_profile_residency_check.value:
("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_outcome" is null) = ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_ref" is null)
       and ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_outcome" is null) = ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_date" is null)
       and ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_outcome" is null) = ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_set_by" is null)
       and ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_outcome" is null) = ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_checksum" is null)
       and ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_outcome" is null or "vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_outcome" in ('positive','negative'))
       and ("vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_checksum" is null or "vendor_profile"."residency_opinion_checksum" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

audit_events_reason_check.name: audit_events_reason_check
audit_events_reason_check.value:
("audit_events"."action" = 'break_glass') = ("audit_events"."reason" is not null)
          and ("audit_events"."reason" is null or char_length("audit_events"."reason") between 15 and 500)

idempotency_records_outcome_check.name: idempotency_records_outcome_check
idempotency_records_outcome_check.value:
("idempotency_records"."status" = 'in_progress' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is null and "idempotency_records"."result" is null and "idempotency_records"."error_code" is null)
       or ("idempotency_records"."status" = 'succeeded' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is not null and "idempotency_records"."error_code" is null)
       or ("idempotency_records"."status" = 'failed' and "idempotency_records"."completed_at" is not null and "idempotency_records"."result" is null and "idempotency_records"."error_code" is not null)

approvals_decision_check.name: approvals_decision_check
approvals_decision_check.value: ("approvals"."state" = 'pending') = ("approvals"."decided_by" is null and "approvals"."decided_at" is null and "approvals"."decided_as" is null)

approvals_maker_checker_check.name: approvals_maker_checker_check
approvals_maker_checker_check.value:
"approvals"."decided_by" is null or "approvals"."decided_by" <> "approvals"."requested_by" or "approvals"."state" = 'cancelled'
          or ("approvals"."owner_self" and "approvals"."requested_as" = 'owner' and "approvals"."decided_as" = 'owner' and length(btrim("approvals"."decision_reason")) >= 10)

notifications_ack_check.name: notifications_ack_check
notifications_ack_check.value:
("notifications"."acknowledged_at" is null) = ("notifications"."acknowledged_by" is null) and ("notifications"."acknowledged_at" is null) = ("notifications"."acknowledged_as" is null)
       and ("notifications"."acknowledged_at" is null) = ("notifications"."acknowledged_name" is null)
